summary: Read a non-empty list of integers whose length is n. One integer appears strictly more often than the floor of n divided by two. Find that integer and write it. You may rely on it always being present, and on there being only one such integer. Every other integer appears too few times to qualify. The length n is at least 1. When n is 1, the single stored integer is the result you write. An integer that appears exactly half the time, when that can happen, is not the answer.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
